headline: Cost of living: Greek households at their limits – they even restrict supermarket purchases
summary: The high cost of living is severely squeezing Greek households, with families restricting their supermarket purchases amid rampant inflation in the country.
why: Persistent inflation in household staples affects consumer spending, which is a major driver of Greece's economic growth and retail sector.
